At Commonwealth Dentistry in Richmond, we’re proud to offer a full selection of dental services right here at our office. We work with all ages and our experienced Richmond dentists have a wealth of experience working in all facets of dentistry, including pediatric, restorative, and much more.
At our Richmond dentist’s office, appointments start on time and you are always squarely at the center of everything we do. We can’t wait for you to see how we make our patients feel special.

We accept most major insurance plans as well as many regional plans. For those without insurance, take advantage of our in-house discount plan.
We’re proud to provide an experience that puts you first. Our appointments always start on time and exceed expectations.
Our Richmond dentist office has specialized pediatric dentists, periodontists, orthodontics, cosmetic dentists, and more on staff.
We’re proud to provide an experience that puts you first. Our appointments always start on time and exceed expectations.

Dr. Rasul attended the University of Maryland, College Park, and was a part of the science, technology, and society scholars program at the university, where she graduated in 2008 with a bachelor’s degree in neurobiology and physiology with a minor in English literature. She also graduated from University of Maryland School of Dentistry in 2012 and was inducted into Gamma Pi Delta, a prosthodontic and operative honor society.

While in dental school, she was a research tech and worked with the head of the endodontic department focusing on vertical root fracture diagnosis. During her final year, Afia was selected for the implant prosthodontics fellowship program to focus on implant restoration. She is a member of the American Dental Association, Virginia Dental Association, and the Richmond Dental Society.
In 2015, she got married and moved to Richmond. Outside the office, Afia loves to travel and spend time with her husband, Zain, and son, Nyle.

Dr. Ayhson Shafiq was born and raised in Springfield, Virginia and earned his undergraduate degree from Virginia Commonwealth University in 2014. He then spent four years at New York University College of Dentistry where he received his Doctor of Dental Surgery.
After completing dental school Dr. Shafiq stayed in New York where he continued to work and complete his General Practice Residency at Maimonides Medical Center.

Working in such a large city allowed him to gain experience treating a variety of patients with a multitude of complex treatment needs. He has extensive knowledge of all modalities of general and cosmetic dentistry including dental crowns, dental bridges, porcelain veneers, Invisalign® clear braces, teeth whitening, dental implant surgery, and more.

Dr. Shafiq knows the value of patient centered care and always tries to put the needs of his patient’s first. He strives to build long lasting, trusting relationships and focuses on restoring natural-looking, healthy smiles.
Despite the completion of his degree Dr. Shafiq continues to hone his skills by keeping up-to-date with the latest dental technology and procedures in the field of general and cosmetic dentistry.
Outside the office you can usually find Dr. Shafiq spending time with his wife and their cat. He is an avid cyclist with a passion for horticulture, vinyl records, and film photography.
